about: Open issues of the harness itself, ranked by bh-rank's key (impact, severity, evidence). Filed to the tracker once one is bound.

findings.summary: No full cycle has ended all met since SG-01 to SG-19 landed; no safeguard has been exercised by a real workflow run, so what the agents do with the new fields and prompts is unknown.
bh-gaps drops a gap whose cited line does not resolve (merge_gaps, rejected list): a refusal, not a fact; whether it stays or becomes a reported fact is the owner's call.
findings.source: toy run 4 rejected a review gap citing a line past the file's end

findings.summary: bh-commit refuses a plan that drops or changes existing targets: a refusal kept so a plan agent cannot lower the bar; awaiting the owner's view.

bh-state time grows with the number of items: 0.33 s at 10, 1.10 s at 100, 9.26 s at 1000 on the scale fixture (one path per item, no test runs); a per-item result cache keyed by the item's tree, or an archive of met items, would bound it.
The packet report runs git reads per unmet item and has not been timed at 1000 items.
SG-16's overlay rule line (a rule id plus covers: AREA) was invented by the builder and is not aligned with the overlay form; nothing has used it.
findings.resolution: The harness reads overlay check opt-outs in exactly the catalog's form (checks/README.md): '- <RULE-ID> not-applicable: <reason>' under '## Check opt-outs'; a line without a reason opts nothing out (test_a_project_opts_a_rule_out_only_in_the_catalogs_form_with_a_reason). The SG-16 'covers: AREA' line is unchanged.

findings.summary: 'In progress' for finish-before-start (SG-17) is defined by the builder as any status other than unmeasured or blocked, or an existing bh/<item> branch; the register entry did not define it.
